scope: Actual two R12 candidate01 GLBs; selected phases recorded below. Head/trunk/leg triangle membership from skin weights, all corners included. Positive AABB gaps prove selected surface separation. For overlaps, direct non-coplanar edge-triangle intersections are counted. Distances are sampled hand vertices to target triangles; not a whole-body collision certificate. Mesh overlap with clothing layers is reported, not interpreted as anatomy.
